task_title: Implement Search, View Toggle, and Sort Features

context.description: Building upon the successfully tested delete and star functionality, we now implement the remaining Phase 1 features: search (title and content), list/grid view toggle, and sort options. These features complete the core note-taking experience before moving to Phase 2 (tags, notebooks, bulk actions).

tech_stack.backend: Rust with Axum, SQLx for database

current_state.services_running: All services verified working (Frontend:3000, Backend:8080, PostgreSQL:5432)
current_state.test_status: All Playwright tests passing (delete, star, visual verification)

implementation_order.reason: Most requested feature, high impact on usability
Enables different browsing modes, complements search
Improves organization, works with both view modes

feature_1_search.name: Search Functionality
feature_1_search.description: Real-time search through note titles and content with visual feedback
feature_1_search.user_story: As a user, I want to search my notes by title or content so I can quickly find specific notes among 557+ entries
acceptance_criteria: Search input appears prominently in Header component
Search works on both title and content fields
Results update in real-time as user types (debounced)
Clear indication when no results found

sql_query_approach.simple_approach: WHERE (LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER($1) OR LOWER(content) LIKE LOWER($1))
sql_query_approach.performance_note: For 557 notes, simple ILIKE is sufficient. Consider GIN index for 10k+ notes

files_to_modify.template: pub async fn search_notes(State(state): State<AppState>, Query(params): Query<SearchParams>) -> Result<Json<Vec<Note>>, StatusCode>
implementation_steps: Define SearchParams struct with q, user_id, limit, offset fields
Build SQL query with WHERE clause for title and content
Use bind() for parameterized query (prevent SQL injection)

testing_commands.expected: Array of notes with 'test' in title or content
Empty array or all notes (depending on implementation)

feature_2_view_toggle.name: List/Grid View Toggle
feature_2_view_toggle.description: Allow users to switch between grid (cards) and list (compact rows) views
feature_2_view_toggle.user_story: As a user, I want to toggle between grid and list views so I can browse my notes in different layouts depending on my task
acceptance_criteria: Toggle button in Header switches between grid and list views
Grid view: Current card layout (4-5 columns)
List view: Compact rows with title, preview, metadata
Both delete and star buttons work in both views

Sorting works with both grid and list views

notes_for_gemini.start_with_backend: Always implement and test backend endpoints first before starting frontend work. This ensures the API contract is solid.
notes_for_gemini.test_incrementally: Test each feature individually before moving to the next. Don't implement all three features at once.
notes_for_gemini.use_existing_patterns: Follow the patterns established in delete/star implementation. The code style is already proven to work.
notes_for_gemini.check_services_first: Always run health-check.ps1 before starting work. If services are down, restart them first.
notes_for_gemini.commit_frequently: If using git, commit after each feature is working. This makes it easy to roll back if needed.
notes_for_gemini.ask_for_clarification: If anything is unclear, ask Steve's Claude for clarification rather than guessing.
